Musical Key: E-flat Major

This is hymn number 107 titled "Lord, Accept Our True Devotion" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Frank W. Asper and the lyrics were written by Hector H. Lee.
